darts.name: Darts
darts.blurb: Throw 501 or Around the Clock on a 3D board.

darts.q1: How do I throw a dart?
darts.a1: Press and hold on the board: the aim marker sways, then settles for about a second. Move to aim and let go to throw. Hold too long and your hand starts to shake again. On a keyboard, the arrow keys aim and Space throws.
darts.a2: Each player starts on 501 and subtracts every score. You must finish exactly on zero with a double or the bull. Going below zero, leaving 1 or finishing on a single is a bust: the turn's score is taken back.
darts.a3: A finish of 170 or less in up to three darts that ends on a double. When you can check out, the page shows the usual route, such as T20 T20 Bull for 170 or D20 for 40.
darts.a4: Easy, medium and hard players aim at the treble 20 or their checkout, with more scatter at the easier levels. Hard averages well over 60.
darts.a5: Your best three-dart average, your fewest darts for a 501 leg and your best Around the Clock stay in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.

darts.s1b: Choose 501, Around the Clock or practice, and play the computer or alone. Press Play.
darts.s2b: Press and hold on the board. The marker sways and steadies after about a second; move it onto your target.
darts.s3b: Release to throw. Three darts make a turn; in 501 finish exactly on a double.

darts.intro: Hold on the board to steady your aim, then let go to throw.
darts.youWin: You win the leg in {n} darts (average {avg})!

darts.hint: Move the mouse to aim, hold to steady and release to throw. Keyboard: arrow keys aim (Shift for bigger steps), hold Space and let go to throw.
darts.hintTouch: Hold on the board to aim (the marker sits just above your finger), slide to adjust and lift to throw.
